intro: Dongers are a loud, energetic family of Japanese-style text faces — usually arms raised in hype, praise, or rage, built from characters like ຈ and ༽. A donger such as ヽ༼ຈل͜ຈ༽ﾉ ("raise your dongers") is plain Unicode text, so it pastes cleanly into chats, comments, and captions. Browse the classics and variants below and click any to copy it instantly. Whether you search "dongers," "donger," or "raise your dongers," every face here is free to copy and paste.
